subject: LIPO
title: Portuguese Conversation
description: Small conversation sections taught entirely in the target language. Emphasis on listening comprehension, speaking, vocabulary building, reading, and culture. Emphasis on the language and culture of Brazil. Must be taken in conjunction with LIPO 1AX.

subject: LIPO
title: Intermediate Brazilian Portuguese for the Social Sciences: Social Movements
description: Conducted entirely in Portuguese. Course aims to improve oral language skills through discussions of social science topics, with emphasis on social and political movements in contemporary Brazil. Course materials may encompass televised news broadcasts, newspapers, and periodicals.
prerequisites_text: LIPO 1D and 1DX or equivalent or by consent of the instructor.

prerequisites_text: LIPO 1D and 1DX or equivalent or by consent of instructor.
